entries.5da1fa3add2df6fe: This business manufactures and sells envelopes used for general office use, shareholder meeting notices, various corporate billing and government notices, including long, square and Western-style envelopes, window envelopes (poly-window and cellophane-window envelopes), postal-insert packaging materials, paper product packaging, and various printed matter, and also operates transport and warehousing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥15,099 million, making it the largest business. The company manufactures and sells the products, with consolidated subsidiary IMURA Printing Co., Ltd. handling commercial printing and Logitec Co., Ltd. handling transport and storage.
